rawContent: @2drdave3 If helping others see their impact and begin the work of being accountable interests you, I wrote a book about it called "Disrupting The Bystander: When #MeToo Happens Among Friends." The book was inspired by disclosures of sex harms, but is applicable to any interpersonal harm.

@amyjccuddy My friend who was listening in and told me that the question came up of how to get bystanders involved when interpersonal harm is happening. I'd love to send you a copy of my book Disrupting The Bystander: When #metoo Happens Among Friends.
